market_analysis.market_definition: The MENA Magnesium Glycinate Market covers magnesium glycinate supplements and finished formulations containing magnesium glycinate as an active nutritional ingredient. The market includes powder, capsules, tablets, softgels, gummies, oral solutions, liquids, and sachets, along with single-ingredient and combination formulations (with vitamins, minerals, herbal/botanical ingredients, amino acids, multi-magnesium) used for magnesium supplementation, general wellness, sleep and relaxation, stress management, muscle health, women's health, sports recovery, and other nutritional applications across the Middle East and North Africa (GCC: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain; Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen), sold through retail and hospital pharmacies, clinics, e-commerce, health and wellness stores, supermarkets, specialty nutrition stores and direct to consumer.
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player is a BRAND OWNER or FINISHED-PRODUCT MANUFACTURER that sells, under its own brand, a finished supplement containing magnesium glycinate (single-ingredient or combination: powder, capsules, tablets, softgels, gummies, liquids or sachets), AND that product is available in at least one MENA country (GCC, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen) -- through pharmacies, retailers, e-commerce or a local distributor. International brands sold in MENA and local MENA brands both qualify; the company need not be headquartered in MENA.
adjacent_segments: Magnesium supplements that do not contain magnesium glycinate (other magnesium salts sold as standalone products)
General vitamin, mineral and dietary supplement brands with no magnesium glycinate product
Food, beverage and cosmetic products outside the nutritional supplement market
Pharmaceutical products not containing magnesium glycinate
Raw-material and ingredient suppliers (magnesium glycinate powder / bisglycinate chelate makers) not selling finished supplements
Distributors, importers and nutraceutical distribution companies of other companies' brands
Pharmacies, retailers, supermarkets and e-commerce platforms (sales channels)
Brands whose magnesium glycinate products are not available in any MENA country
